name: Auto Alternative Terminals
summary: Automatically select matching backup terminals for new stops and station expansions.
description:
Adds matching alternative terminals when you add a stop to a line or expand a station. Candidates must belong to the same station group and match the transport mode and passenger/cargo use.

Enable the mod in your save, then add a line stop or expand a station. Existing manual choices, including Don't Use, are preserved. Extending an existing platform does not re-enable it. When the preferred terminal changes, the previous one is added as an alternative if it is eligible.

Supports bus, truck, tram, ship, plane and helicopter terminals inside stations. Train lines and roadside stops are excluded. Matching does not guarantee a reachable route; check connections or disable an unsuitable alternative if a path error appears. Disabling the mod keeps the saved terminal settings. Avoid other mods that automatically change line terminal choices.

zh_CN.name: 自动备用站台
zh_CN.summary: 为新增停靠站和扩建站台自动补选匹配的备用位置，保留手动设置。
zh_CN.description:
在线路新增停靠站或车站扩建时，自动补选备用位置。候选站台须与主站台同属一个站点组，且运输方式和客货用途匹配。

在存档中启用后，添加停靠站或扩建站台即可。已有手动选择及“不使用”设置会保留；延长原站台不会重新启用已停用的位置。切换首选时，符合条件的旧首选会补为备用。

支持公交、货车、有轨电车、船舶、飞机和直升机的车站内站台；火车线路和路边停靠点不参与。备用匹配不保证路网可达，出现无路径提示时请检查连接或停用该位置。停用模组后保留已写入的设置。避免同时启用其他自动修改线路站台选择的模组。
